evaluation_protocol: Every policy is evaluated once on every RL test session (test_user_indices of data/processed_cache.npz): one episode per test user at horizon 10 (test_k10) and horizon 20 (test_k20). DQN policies act greedily (epsilon = 0) over the valid-action mask; RandomPolicy uses a fresh generator seeded with 42 in every evaluation. Ranking metrics treat a step as relevant when the recommended slot holds a real rating >= 4.0; recall, NDCG and MAP use the number of liked slots of the session as the relevant set. catalog_coverage is the number of distinct movies recommended divided by the number of distinct movies in the evaluated sessions' candidate slates (padding slots excluded).

paired_comparisons.protocol: K = 10 test sessions, one episode per test user and policy. For each pair (A, B) and metric, the per-user difference is A - B. mean_diff is its mean, [ci95_low, ci95_high] the percentile 95% CI of a paired bootstrap over users (10,000 resamples, seed 42), and wilcoxon_p_value the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p-value (scipy.stats.wilcoxon, zero differences dropped; p = 1 when every difference is zero). All values are rounded to 4 decimals, so p-values below 0.00005 appear as 0.0.

w1_report_funksvd.protocol: Static one-shot evaluation reported in the Workshop 1 report: RMSE and MAE of FunkSVD with k = 50 (Table I); top-10 ranking metrics of the tuned FunkSVD with k = 20 (Table III) under a sampled-negative protocol, where each test user's liked test items are ranked together with sampled movies not seen in train; coverage and novelty describe the top-10 lists over the Workshop 1 catalog. Not comparable 1:1 with the Workshop 3 sessions, where a policy picks 10 of at most 50 real ratings of one session and coverage is measured over the movies of the evaluated sessions.
w1_report_funksvd.source: workshop1_reference (values transcribed from the Workshop 1 report, with locations)

w3_sequential_greedy_funksvd.source: test_k10.GreedyFunkSVD: greedy on the Workshop 3 FunkSVD scores (k = 20, trained on the same 80% training split) in the Workshop 3 environment

w2_hybrid_neumf_static.source: runs/evaluation_summary.json (hybrid_test_metrics; ranking_comparison['HybridNeuMF (W2 Deep CF)']), runs/training_history.json (one row per epoch), data/splits.json (counts)
w2_hybrid_neumf_static.protocol: Static one-shot Workshop 2 evaluation on the global chronological 80/10/10 split that Workshop 3 also uses. RMSE, MAE and ROC-AUC cover all clean test ratings. The top-10 metrics follow a sampled-candidate protocol, not a full-catalog ranking (src/baselines.py evaluate_ranking): each test user with liked (rating >= 4.0) test items ranks them together with 200 sampled unrated movies (200 movies drawn at random from the catalog, minus those the user rated in train), scored by clamp(prediction, 0.5, 5) + 1.35 x normalized log train popularity.
w2_hybrid_neumf_static.ratings_processed_note: train_ratings x training_epochs: one pass over the training split per logged HybridNeuMF epoch. The BiasedMF pretraining epochs of src/train.py (PRETRAIN_EPOCHS) are not logged in runs/training_history.json and are not counted.

w3_sequential_greedy_hybrid_neumf.source: test_k10.GreedyHybridNeuMF: GreedyHybridNeuMFPolicy acting on data/w2_candidate_scores.npz in the Workshop 3 environment
w3_sequential_greedy_hybrid_neumf.score_definition: HybridNeuMF.forward(u, i) of checkpoints/model_best.pt in eval mode under torch.no_grad(), without the [0.5, 5.0] clamp used for RMSE (monotone, so the ranking is unchanged); padding slots (cand_valid == 0) hold -1e+09

sample_efficiency.criterion: steps_to_surpass_<baseline> is the cumulative number of training environment steps at the first champion validation checkpoint (training_logs.json champion_run.val_checkpoints, greedy policy, every RL validation session once, episode 0 included) whose mean_return strictly exceeds the baseline's mean_return on the same validation sessions; the _ndcg_at_10 variant uses NDCG@10. null means no checkpoint surpasses the baseline. The MyopicBandit reference is its saved (best validation return) checkpoint.

trajectory_selection: Test users at the evenly spaced positions [0, 59, 117, 176] of the 177 RL test users (test_user_indices order), fixed before evaluation and independent of any outcome; the champion (top level) and the gamma = 0 policy (myopic_bandit) run the same sessions.
